scope: Audio and MIDI record, edit, save, reopen and play journey through the production QML, with links to the recording receipts
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12), docker --network none, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, synthetic QTest pointer and keyboard input, silent preview audio, previewMidi() standing in for a MIDI device
journey: Save through the project field and Save button
Click Arm on the audio and MIDI tracks
Click Record, play two MIDI notes, click Stop: two takes become selected clips
Piano roll: click note 1, Right moves it a sixteenth (48 to 72 ticks), Up raises it to 61
Type 25 ms into the audio take's range start (1,200 frames)
A fresh window opens the project through the project field and Open: notes [[72,48,61],[144,48,64]] and range 1,200 frames intact
Click both clip buttons and Play: both takes active, the moved note sounding
limits: Synthetic input offscreen, not native Wayland input (#22); preview audio is silent and MIDI comes from previewMidi(), not a physical interface or controller (#19). The live input paths are covered by the private-graph receipts linked above.
